summary: What you are approving: four changes that together turn a one-email-then-suspend flow into a recovery flow. (1) Enable Stripe Smart Retries and record every retry attempt locally so we can report on it. (2) Replace the single failure email with a short sequence that tells the customer what failed and gives a one-click card update link, sent on the retry schedule. (3) Add an admin page listing at-risk accounts with retry history, so support can intervene before day 7. (4) Delay suspension until Stripe reports the final retry failed, instead of a fixed 7 days. Revision 2 addresses the Gate 1 comment that suspension timing was missing: it is now its own item (wi-suspension-timing) because it changes a customer-visible rule and needs a product decision on the maximum grace period. Out of scope: changing plans or prices, bank-transfer customers, and any new payment provider.

work_items.title: Enable Stripe Smart Retries and record attempts
work_items.intent: Stripe retries failed charges on its own schedule; we subscribe to the invoice.payment_failed and invoice.paid webhooks and store each attempt in a new payment_attempts table so recovery can be measured and shown to support.

work_items.title: Dunning email sequence with card-update link
work_items.intent: Customers get a clear, plain-language email at first failure and after each failed retry, each with a signed one-click link to update their card. Replaces the single existing failure email.
work_items.notes: Copy for the emails needs product sign-off; the spec should include the copy as an acceptance criterion so it is reviewed at Gate 2.

work_items.title: At-risk accounts admin view
work_items.intent: Support sees every account with an open failed payment, days since first failure, retry attempts so far, and the last email sent, and can trigger a manual retry or extend grace.

work_items.title: Suspend on final retry failure, not day 7
work_items.intent: Account suspension moves from a fixed 7-day timer to the moment Stripe reports the last retry failed, with a configurable maximum grace period as a safety cap.
work_items.notes: Owner must set the maximum grace period. Default proposed: 21 days.

coverage.rationale: Retries recover charges; support intervenes on the rest; suspension no longer fires while recovery is still possible.
Smart Retries raise the mechanical recovery rate; the email sequence with a card-update link addresses the cases a retry cannot fix (expired or replaced card).
Direct: the admin view is the deliverable.

explicitly_out_of_scope: Bank transfer and invoice-paid customers (different failure mode; separate outcome)
Changing plan prices or offering discounts to at-risk customers (owner said no; pricing is frozen)
In-app banners about failed payments (valuable, but the app shell is owned by another team; proposed as a follow-up outcome)

open_questions.question: What is the maximum grace period before suspension regardless of Stripe's retry schedule?
Should the dunning emails go to the billing contact only, or to all admins on the account?
open_questions.default_if_unanswered: Billing contact, with admins CC'd on the final notice

assumptions: Stripe Smart Retries is available on our Stripe account tier (it is on Billing Starter and above).
The existing webhook endpoint already verifies Stripe signatures (confirmed at app/controllers/webhooks/stripe_controller.rb:14-22).
Metabase can read the new payment_attempts table through the existing replica.

risks.risk: Webhook replay or out-of-order delivery double-counts attempts
risks.mitigation: payment_attempts keyed by Stripe event id with a unique index; spec for wi-smart-retries must include an idempotency criterion.

risks.risk: Email sequence annoys customers whose payment recovers on the first retry
risks.mitigation: Each email is sent only after a failed retry, and the sequence stops on invoice.paid.
